KHL Webcaster Events

Source: R/khl.R
khl_webcaster_events.Rd

Games of a stage, 16 per page (one row per game; khl_id is the khl.ru game id).

Usage

khl_webcaster_events(
  season = NULL,
  stage = "regular",
  page = 1,
  stage_id = NULL,
  team_ids = NULL,
  start_after = NULL,
  start_before = NULL,
  locale = "en",
  return_parsed = TRUE
)

Arguments

season

Season by its END year (2026 = 2025-26), mapped to the KHL webcaster stage id through the webcaster season table (khl_webcaster_stages). NULL = the current stage.

stage

Which stage of the season: regular or playoff. One of regular, playoff.

page

1-based page of 16 games; an empty page ends the stage.

stage_id

Webcaster stage id, sent as is instead of season / stage (370 = 2025-26 regular season; khl_webcaster_stages lists them). Not a khl.ru tournament id.

team_ids

Webcaster team id(s) (khl_webcaster_teams id, not a khl.ru club id): games of these teams.

start_after

Games starting after this unix time (seconds). Needs a stage.

start_before

Games starting before this unix time (seconds). Needs a stage.

locale

Response language: en or ru. One of en, ru.

return_parsed

Logical. TRUE (default) returns the parsed fastRhockey_data tibble; FALSE returns the raw JSON body as a list (betting fields and the caller's IP removed).

Value

A fastRhockey_data tibble (54 columns; zero rows with the same columns when the payload is empty), or the raw body as a list when return_parsed = FALSE. Raises fastRhockey_no_data (nothing there, or an unknown season / stage), fastRhockey_asset_fetch (an error envelope, an answer for another id than the one asked, or a failed fetch) and fastRhockey_bad_request (an invalid argument or an HTTP 400 / 422).

Details

Endpoint: GET https://khl.api.webcaster.pro/api/khl_mobile/events_v2.json.

The webcaster API is keyless JSON. Neither backend takes a year: season (the END year, 2026 = 2025/26) and stage are mapped to the webcaster stage id through the season table of khl_webcaster_stages() (cached for the R session), or pass stage_id. Honours getOption("fastRhockey.proxy"); betting fields and the caller's IP are removed from every body.

Ids and counts are integers (sdv-py Int64); a column holding values past 2^31 (epoch milliseconds) is returned as a whole-number double.

At least one second is left between two requests to a host.

Owner flag (sanctions). The KHL and its webcaster platform are run by Russian operators, some clubs by sanctioned state companies. Fetching on your own machine is fine; any published data release, hosted mirror or redistribution needs owner (sanctions / legal) sign-off first.
